anchor: What trinket gives me a bit more armor and can cancel a failed roll against death magic or undead harm a dozen times before crumbling?
Which top-tier charm gives me an edge on rolls to resist magic and needs me to bond with it before it works?
Can my devoted healer ask the heavens to step in and cast a mid-level magic effect for free, only once until I get a full night's sleep?
Out of slots in a pinch, can a devout caster cast a fifth-level or lower magic effect free of cost, if it doesn't need a quick response?
Which minor magic trick gives a willing ally a little d4 boost on one skill check of their choice, lasting a minute while I keep my focus?
Which giant winged reptile can burrow through earth, fly at 80 feet, and breathe a 90-foot line of electricity that hits each creature in its path?
What great beast can shrug off a failed roll to resist, turning it into a success, three times a day, and is immune to shock damage?
Which enormous animal can knock a big creature flat if it rushes straight at it from 20 feet away?
What giant beast can stomp a fallen foe for around 17 crushing harm, letting the victim roll a dodge check to halve it?
What spell lets me order a creature I can see to do a task of my choosing, punishing it with heavy mental harm if it defies me?
Which magic lasts about a month and ends early if someone casts a curse-breaking spell, a deep healing spell, or a wish?
Which reptilian monster needs to catch sight of its own mirror image before its stare can turn a victim to stone after two failed rolls?
What slow-moving creature with a venomous bite and roughly 52 hit points has a gaze that holds victims in place?
Which sea-dwelling creature can breathe both underwater and in air, and throws a spear that flies back into its hand after each ranged attack?
What aquatic foe's spear jabs chill me and slow my movement by ten feet, hitting from as far as 60 feet away?
Which hellish brute snares victims with linked iron and reappears in its home plane after being slain away from it?
What otherworldly brute shrugs off blunt, piercing, and cutting weapons, ignores fire and poison, and is hard to sway with magic?
Which craftsman's kit lets me learn what a clay vessel held over the past day, and can make jugs and lamps?
What weapon can send nearby foes into a panicked flight from me for a minute, but gets used up after three uses and recharges at dawn?
Which blunt weapon forces each creature I pick to spend its turns fleeing, and lets them try a roll at the end of each turn to shake it off?
What magic fires three flaming beams at once, each needing a hit roll, and each beam does 2d6 burning harm?
Which low-level magic reaches 120 feet and creates one extra beam for each stronger slot I spend?
When my innate-magic character reaches level three, what lets me pick a path that grants extra abilities as I keep leveling?
Which fifth-level trick conjures a solid object from dark planar stuff, lasting a day if wood and only ten minutes if it's a gem?
If I've studied an item, can shadow-born magic reproduce it, no bigger than a five-foot box that grows with stronger slots?
When my song-and-spell caster hits third level, which choice do I make to unlock extra talents later on?
Which nature-linked caster can spend a shapeshift use to summon a little animal helper, and it vanishes after a full night's rest?
Can I spend a spell slot to conjure an animal helper that's one of the spirit-world folk, without any physical reagents?
Which sixth-level magic lets me give up to a dozen listeners a 25-word nudge, like a short walk to a village, that holds them for a full day unless someone hurts them?
How do I make a dozen listeners keep carrying out my nudge for ten days, and what slot does that require?
Which small creature drops onto prey, wraps around the head to blind and suffocate, and can cloak an area in gloom no sight penetrates?
Once a clinging ambusher has latched onto me, what kind of strength check with what difficulty pulls it free?
At high level, can my healing hands also cure someone frozen in place or unable to hear, and what does each cure cost from my healing pool?
If I spend points from my divine healing to clear a charm, a blindness and a stun from an ally, does that also heal their hit points?
Which fifth-level magic draws a floor ring to open a doorway to a known permanent ring, lasting until my next turn ends?
How many consecutive days of casting in one spot does it take to make a doorway ring that never vanishes?
When an attack hurts me, can I take a quick instinctive step to halve harm of that kind for the rest of the round?
Which eighth-level ward makes a touched ally immune to thought-based harm and charm, and hides them from any magic that reads thoughts or finds them?
If I shield an ally, can even a wish-level magic fail to learn their location or sense their emotions for a whole day?
What worn band cuts the harm from frost attacks by 2d8 and keeps me and my gear safe in temperatures of zero degrees or colder?
Which uncommon jewelry needs me to bond with it before it trims the sting of frost attacks?
What low-cost magic steadies a fallen friend who's at zero hit points and not dead, reaching 15 feet and doubling at levels 5, 11, and 17?
If a companion has dropped to zero and is still breathing, how do I stop them from slipping away with no healing?
What is the state where my body turns to rock, my weight jumps tenfold, I stop aging, and I'm unable to act or move?
Under what condition do I automatically fail Strength and Dexterity rolls to resist effects, yet take half harm from everything and shrug off toxins?
Which holy warrior gets to pick two first-tier prayers at start and swap one each night's rest, with more picks as they level?
If a separate feature hands my holy warrior certain spells always ready, do those count against how many I can pick?
What big river-dwelling animal can hold its breath for ten minutes and bites for around 16 harm?
Which bulky, low-intellect creature bites twice per turn, has about 82 hit points, and can't talk?
When I'm barehanded or only holding simple or light melee weapons without armor or a shield, can I throw an extra punch as a quick action?
Can a nimble fist-fighter use Dexterity for attacks and damage with bare hands or light weapons, and to set the difficulty of resisting a shove?
What deadly sneak-killer uses toxin-coated short blades and crossbows, and can slip away from half-damage effects?
Which thief-like humanoid can dart, hide or step back as a quick extra move, and makes three strikes per turn?
Which staff-like item gives me a keen eye for spotting things and quick reactions to start a fight, and lets me detect magic or see invisible foes?
Can a magic baton I stick into the ground make a 60-foot-radius glow that gives allies a small bonus to armor and saves and reveals invisible foes?
Which instrument, when blown, calls warrior spirits from another plane that stay for an hour and can't be scared or charmed?
What happens if I summon warrior spirits with a metal instrument I'm not qualified to play, and how long until I can do it again?
How long and how many gold coins does it take to write a newly found spell of a given level into my magic book?
After my tome gets lost, is copying my prepared magic into a new one cheaper and quicker than writing new magic from scratch?
How can I make a foe in view either roll a quick dodge or take 1d8 of light-based harm that cover can't blunt?
Which low-level magic deals light-based harm that grows from 1d8 to 2d8 at level five and 4d8 by level seventeen?
Once I'm past level 19, which epic perk lets me slip out of sight with a quick extra move in dim light and boosts an ability score?
In dim light, which high-tier ability lets me shrug off most harm except mind-bending and radiant harm?
Which mind-altering magic lets me rewrite a creature's recollection, and does a remove curse or deep healing restore the true version?
If I alter a creature's mind about an event from up to a week ago, will an absurd false tale stick or get dismissed as a dream?
Which tiny winged animal has a single hit point and bites for just 1 damage, but can barely walk on the ground?
What small airborne creature can sense nearby things without relying on sight out to 60 feet and moves along the ground at only 5 feet?
Which species can see 60 feet in darkness and picks a heritage tied to the lower planes for resistance to poison, necrotic, or fire harm?
What species gets two free bonus spells at character levels 3 and 5 depending on its chosen ancestral bloodline?
Which ooze divides into two when a slicing or lightning attack hits it, and its corrosive touch can wear down armor?
What slime monster hits from 10 feet away for about 17 corrosive harm, and only multiplies while it's still mid-size or larger?
What small jewelry adds one point to my armor and my rolls to resist harm, but requires bonding first?
Which satchel can hold up to 500 pounds of stuff yet weighs only 5 pounds, though tearing it or overloading it dumps everything into another plane?
If I stuff a roomy sack into an extradimensional space made by a similar pouch, do both vanish and does a creature nearby get pulled into another plane?
